title: The same website, built the way big sites do it
about: Big sites split the front door into two specialists. One remembers recent answers so most visitors never reach a real server. The other checks every second which servers are healthy and sends visitors only to those.
tryThis: Stop ha2-back-a and watch the load balancer notice within a few seconds. Stop both back servers to see the friendly 'we are down' page.

roles.ha2-varnish: The memory. It keeps a fresh answer for 10 seconds and replies instantly without bothering the servers.
roles.ha2-haproxy: The traffic controller. It asks each server 'are you OK?' every second and skips the ones that are not.
roles.ha2-back-a: One of two identical web servers that build the page.
